name: 慈照寺东求堂
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a Fanggu heritage colored plate. Image 1 is the generated black line drawing and controls the exact building silhouette, openings and composition. Image 2 is the real monument photo and controls present-day materials and colors. Image 3 is ONLY the project colored-line STYLE sample, never copy its Chinese hall geometry or warm gold palette. Make a restrained architectural color illustration of the SAME exact building, with clean thin contour lines and modest natural material texture. The exterior canvas and all open spaces must be flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, ready for later local transparency preparation. No scene, ground, trees, people, cast shadow, gradient, paper texture, glow, checkerboard, text, labels, watermark or frame. Subject: Jisho-ji Togudo, the ACTUAL 1485-86 surviving square Buddhist/residential pavilion at Ginkaku-ji, distinct from the two-storey Silver Pavilion. Preserve one-story hip-and-gable bark roof, white walls with dark timber grid, wood veranda and low elevation; remove the pine, tourists and signboard. Material observations: Dark brown hinoki-bark roof, warm natural timber frame, off-white plaster walls, dark lattice openings and aged wood veranda.
material_observations: 按同主体实拍区分现状材质色，不推定初建时原色。
